table.retrieve:
SELECT
      source=(select name from godown where godown.gcode=theader.sgcode),
      target=(select name from godown where godown.gcode=theader.dgcode),
      theader.transcode,
      theader.date,
      theader.postdate,
      theader.posted,  
      qty=sum(tdetail.qty),
		UnitPrice = Case :ai_pricetype 
								WHEN 2 THEN Round(max(tdetail.purprice) / tdetail.PackUnits, 2)
                     	WHEN 1 THEN Round(max(tdetail.Saleprice) / tdetail.PackUnits, 2)
                     	WHEN 3 THEN Round(max(tdetail.avgprice), 2)
                     END ,
      theader.sgcode,
      theader.dgcode,
      item.name,
      item.customicode
 
FROM item,tdetail,theader

WHERE theader.date>=:adt_sdate and 
      theader.date<=:adt_ldate and
      theader.posted='Y' and
      theader.transcode=tdetail.transcode and
		theader.sgcode IN (:al_sourcegodown) and
		theader.dgcode = :al_targetgodown and
      tdetail.icode=item.icode 

group by theader.transcode,
         item.name,
         item.customicode,
         theader.posted,
         theader.sgcode,
         theader.dgcode,
			tdetail.packunits,
			theader.date,
         theader.postdate
          

ORDER BY  theader.date,theader.transcode
